newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal unemployed down 0.2 pct yr/yr Jan.
newsitem.headline: Portugal unemployed down 0.2 pct yr/yr Jan.

text.p: The number of registered unemployed fell 0.2 percent year-on-year and rose 2.3 percent month-on-month in January to 470,783, the Employment Ministry said in a statement.
It gave no figures for the percentage of the workforce who were unemployed.
"There is an important braking in the worsening of unemployment," the statement said.
"This braking is explained by a recovery in economic activity and by an increase in the efficiency of employment policies," it added.
Portugal's unemployment rate stood at 7.2 percent in the fourth quarter 1996, according to official figures of the National Statistics Institute.
